statements.t: The interest in new sales opportunities in the convenience store and travel plaza segments are continuing, and with the new franchise agreements sold and a backlog of prospects, the Company expects the revenue trend to continue increasing.
These reductions reflect increased revenue with little change in operating costs, and the Company currently expects this trend to continue in the near term.
The Company does not intend to operate any more Company-owned non-traditional locations.
The Company does not currently expect those expenses to grow significantly in the future though the rate of annual additions to non-traditional locations is expected to continue and accelerate.
Net income before income tax is important as there will be no cash payments for income tax in the next several years because of the company’s deferred tax asset.

risks.t: competitive factors and pricing and cost pressures
the Company’s ability to service its loan
the emergence or spread of human or animal pandemics (such as COVID-19 or the Avian Bird Flu)
non-renewal of franchise agreements or contemplated openings not occurring
war or other global or regional disruptions
changes in demand for the Company’s products or franchises
the success or failure of individual franchisees
other changes in prices or supplies of food ingredients and labor
